body:
A design can be clicked through like an interactive mockup: following a link on one screen shows another.

### Do

- Add `action` (a name) and `navigates_to` (a screen in the same design) to the validator's table, for elements that can be clicked. A `navigates_to` naming a missing screen is refused.
- In the renderer, clicking such an element shows the target screen. `action` is recorded in the design only and does nothing when clicked.

### Watch out for

Later, clicking an element selects it for notes and direct editing (feature:afd9fe8bae36c59c, feature:c3bed08cc1bbbbb8). Keep the click behavior easy to switch. Ask the human how a preview is started and left, since the design view doesn't have one yet.

### Acceptance

- Tests: a valid link validates and a click shows the target screen, a missing screen is refused, and an action alone changes nothing when clicked.

### Left out

Screen states and mock data.
title: ui: click-through preview
